scope: Current three-group VCORE topology, local F interleaving, bounded ordinary-via access and C18.1 return context. No PCB, manifest, fill, CAD, placement or rule write.

geometric_interleaving.interpretation: Screens use complete existing VCORE terminal sets, 0.25 mm F candidates and exact current F obstacles. Feasible means an unblocked tested polyline, not a qualified full route.

C18_ground_context.disposition: C18.1 remains an isolated GND terminal with no existing through-via. Its local return should be dispositioned before accepting a west-load VCORE feed, to avoid repeating supply-before-return closure.

candidate_screen.In1_note: A VCORE through-via inside actual MAIN In1 requires a refill-generated antipad; current GND fill overlap is not treated as fixed copper, but plane continuity remains a later acceptance gate.

candidate_topologies_for_Astra.name: local_F_source_to_east_then_separate_west_strategy
candidate_topologies_for_Astra.engineering_question: Existing F interleaving blocks the bounded local source-to-east forms; a topology or corridor decision is required.
candidate_topologies_for_Astra.qualification: Geometric corridor evidence only; not a complete VCORE route or PI/current qualification.

candidate_topologies_for_Astra.name: off_contact_F_to_In2_distribution
candidate_topologies_for_Astra.engineering_question: Astra must decide source/east/west transition count, In2 distribution width/topology, antipad/return-plane consequences and whether C18.1 GND is repaired first.
candidate_topologies_for_Astra.qualification: Local ordinary-via access only; no In2 route, plane refill or full-network feasibility is claimed.

current_budget_evidence.qualification_limit: No accepted report establishes VCORE load, voltage-drop, temperature-rise or transient targets. Width judgment cannot be promoted from geometry alone.

preserved_dependencies: accepted C13 GND stitch and continuous In1 MAIN
IMU routing, USB, clock and existing critical routes

reused_views.applicability: Exact accepted PCB bytes match the staged view source; views provide local copper context but do not include proposed VCORE geometry.

limits: No route is authorized or saved.
No full power network, PI, current, thermal, stackup or fabrication qualification.
A blocked bounded form is not proof that placement or all layer strategies are impossible.
